name: Reputational salary

subjectOf.text: Faking a reputable expertise tag is nearly costless: a successful tag's open record can be copied and reposted under a new name for the price of the anti denial of service fees, and the capital used to mimic fees paid into the sham tag is mostly recovered by the sham owners through the salaries they control.
subjectOf.abstract: easily be copied and reposted under a new tag name for the low cost of the anti-DoS fees. The capital used to mimic fees paid to the sham expertise tag is mostly recovered by the sham owners through the salaries they control.
subjectOf.citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Vlad Andrei, Blockchain Infrastructure for Measuring Domain Specific Reputation in Autonomous Decentralized and A (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3125822
scope_conditions: sham owners hold the majority of the sham tag's tokens

subjectOf.text: All fees should be shared with the entire network of reputation holders in proportion to their holdings, because this reputational salary is what makes reputation tokens valuable and future-oriented.
subjectOf.abstract: All fees should be shared with the entire net- work of reputation holders relative to their holdings. This is the key to making reputa- tion tokens valuable and future-oriented.
subjectOf.citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, The Importance of Reputation for the Evolution of Decentralization (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782210
